description: Return the current billing-cycle usage for the authenticated organization: total / used / available credits, used quota percent, max concurrency, and cycle reset time. Call this before launching large scrape jobs to confirm available credit.
name: usage

available_credits.description: Remaining credits (max(0, total_credits - used_credits)). Clamped to 0 when in overage.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent jobs allowed for this organization (plan base + purchased + gifted extras).

total_credits.description: Total credits available for the current billing cycle (plan base + purchased + gifted).

usage_reset.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the current billing cycle ends and used_credits resets.

used_credits.description: Credits spent so far in the current billing cycle. May exceed total_credits on plans that allow overages.

used_quota_percent.description: Percentage of total_credits used in the current cycle, rounded to 1 decimal. Not capped — values >100 indicate overage.

title: Get current usage
